title: clompanus roxburghii
intro: Clompanus roxburghii, commonly known as the Roxburgh's snake wood or Roxburgh's snakewood, is a plant species found in the Western Ghats of India. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Clompanus roxburghii include analgesic, antiarthritic, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
